d: What goes into creating an extraordinary cake? At Carlo's Bakery, Buddy Valastro and his talented team bring imagination, skill and precision together to create amazing cakes. From planning unique concepts and choosing intricate designs to baking, sculpting and professional cake decorating, every stage demands creativity and craftsmanship. Get a closer look at the process behind elaborate themed cakes and discover what makes Buddy and his team stand out in the world of custom cakes. Watch Cake Boss Season 8 for incredible creations and memorable moments, only on discovery+ India.
